title: Dependency Resolution
description: Solves the version puzzle - finding a set of package versions that satisfy all constraints - automatically at environment build time. Good resolvers produce a lockfile so the solved environment reproduces exactly everywhere.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Hermetic Builds
description: Seals the build from the host - no network, no ambient tools - so the environment contains exactly the declared inputs. Hermetic builds are reproducible by construction: same inputs, same environment, every time.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Environment Variable Management
description: Manages configuration through versioned environment files with clear precedence - defaults, environment, local overrides. Explicit variable management ends the 'works on my machine' mystery of hidden local config.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Secret Injection
description: Delivers secrets into the environment at runtime from a vault, never storing them in files or images. Injection keeps secrets out of version control, container layers, and shell history - the three places they most often leak.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Container Layering
description: Builds environment images in cacheable layers - base, dependencies, code - so rebuilds reuse unchanged layers. Layering makes environment builds fast and sharing efficient: teams pull only the layers that changed.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Reproducible Environments
description: Defines the entire environment - OS packages, language versions, variables - as code that rebuilds identically anywhere. Reproducible environments end configuration drift between developers, CI, and production.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dev/Prod Parity
description: Keeps development and production environments as similar as possible so bugs reproduce and fixes transfer. Parity attacks the classic failure where code works locally but breaks in production due to environment differences.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Feature Flags
description: Gates features behind runtime flags so code ships dark and activates without redeploying. Flags decouple deployment from release, enabling gradual rollouts and instant kill-switches.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Config Validation
description: Validates configuration against schemas before the environment starts, catching typos and type errors at build time. Validated config means the service never discovers a bad setting by crashing at 2 AM.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Infrastructure as Code
description: Defines servers, networks, and services in versioned code that a tool reconciles with reality. IaC makes infrastructure reviewable, repeatable, and auditable - the same guarantees code review gives software.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Environment Cloning
description: Spins up exact copies of production for debugging and testing in minutes, with data sanitized appropriately. Cloning lets engineers reproduce production bugs in a safe sandbox instead of debugging live.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Drift Detection
description: Continuously compares running environments against their declared specification and reports differences. Drift detection catches the manual 'quick fixes' that silently diverge environments until something breaks.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Teardown Automation
description: Destroys temporary environments completely - VMs, networks, DNS, storage - when their TTL expires, so nothing lingers to bill or to attack. Automated teardown is what makes ephemeral environments economical.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Cost Guards
description: Enforces spending limits on environments - auto-pausing idle dev boxes, capping CI parallelism - so experimentation never produces surprise bills. Guards make cloud costs predictable without manual policing.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Environment Templates
description: Provides one-click templates - 'Python data science', 'Rust service', 'Node API' - that generate complete working environments. Templates encode team best practices so new projects start correct instead of converging over months.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
